_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: 16-digit numeric string, unique across the database

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

app.description: Application context of the document: Auto = automotive caliper MES, Gamp = pharmaceutical GMP, Common = reference data shared by both

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mast_site.name

identityType.description: Equipment, IoT Edge gateway or MES publisher

iotHubName.description: Azure IoT Hub the identity is registered in

equipmentName.description: Display value of equipmentId, copied from u_mes_mast_equipment.name

iotDeviceName.description: Display value of iotDeviceId, copied from u_mes_syst_iotDevice.name

parentIotHubIdentityId.description: Reference to u_mes_syst_iotHubIdentity._id: parent IoT hub IDentity

parentIotHubIdentityName.description: Display value of parentIotHubIdentityId, copied from u_mes_syst_iotHubIdentity.name

authenticationMethod.description: How the identity authenticates to IoT Hub

certificateThumbprint.description: SHA-1 thumbprint of the client certificate; null for symmetric key authentication

certificateExpiresAt.description: Expiry of the client certificate; null for symmetric key authentication

provisioningStatus.description: State of the identity in IoT Hub

lastRegistrySyncAt.description: Last time the registry sync service wrote the identity and its twin tags; null before the first sync

twinTagsVersion.description: Version of the twin tags last written; increases with each master data change that touches the identity

lastSyncErrorText.description: Error of the last failed sync; null when the last sync succeeded

connectionState.description: Last connection state reported by IoT Hub

connectionStateAt.description: Time of the last device connection state event; null when the identity never connected

status.description: Primary lifecycle state of the document

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1
